cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with Takayasu's arteritis who gave birth at Fernandez Hospital, Hyderabad, between 2005 and 2022.
finding: The study found a live birth rate of 84%, 10% miscarriages, 5% stillbirths, a 59.3% Caesarean section rate, and one maternal mortality, concluding that maternal and foetal outcomes are generally good with appropriate diagnosis and management.
